newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.209 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.209 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves fell $170 million, or 1.11 percent,to $15.209 billion, in the week to January 13 according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were down from $15.379 billion on January 7, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Foreign reserves are now up $5.507 billion from reserve levels of $9.702 billion on April 19 -- the last working day before exchange controls were lifted on April 22 last year.
The sustained rise has complicated monetary policy, government officials have said, increasing liquidity. Reserves are expected to top $20 billion by the end of 1997, officials have said.
